Dashboard

Bulk Entry Sheet — register in bulk, spreadsheet-style.

Just paste from Excel to register multiple tasks at once.

Paste like Excel

Just copy a range from spreadsheet software and paste it into the cells. Subject, description, start date, and due date are required

Link parent/child tasks in bulk with row IDs

Just reference a row's ID from another row's parent-task field — they're linked automatically once registered

Inline validation as you go

Instantly flags missing required fields per cell. Already-registered rows are grayed out to prevent resubmission

Speed up routine entries with row templates

Save and recall frequently used input patterns. Also supports bulk import via CSV drag & drop

Cut down the effort of registering tasks, all at once.

Stop registering tasks one by one — bulk-register them spreadsheet-style instead.

Backlog My Tasks

A Chrome extension that lets you check and manage your assigned Backlog tasks across multiple spaces in one place. 8 views and a project dashboard make daily task management and team progress tracking easier.
